summary: Describes mailbox referrals for IMAP4, which let a server tell a client that a mailbox actually lives on a different IMAP server. Clients can then follow the pointer without the user noticing. This helps organizations spread mailboxes across several servers while presenting one view of them.

eli5.summary: Imagine asking a librarian for a book and she says it is in the other building, then walks you there. Your email program gets sent to the right computer automatically.

questions: what is an imap mailbox referral
how do imap clients find mailboxes on other servers
